author: pdoom-data maintainers
description: Default candidate-ordering profile. Estimates how notable a record is likely to be, from external signals only. This is a WEIGHTING CHOICE, not a property of the world -- another consumer weighting differently is not wrong, they are answering a different question.
what_this_is_not: Not source quality. That is a separate axis (provenance and length).
Not an editorial verdict. Human verdicts live in attributed reviews[].
Not authoritative. Add your own profile file rather than forking records.
method: For each (kind, year) group: score records by the kind's signal, convert to percentile rank within the group, shrink toward 0.5 by group size, then multiply by topical relevance. Grouping by year prevents a 2016 model competing against a 2026 one; shrinkage stops the top member of a tiny group scoring a perfect 1.0 on the strength of one comparison.
shrinkage_note: A group needs roughly this many members before its internal percentile is trusted at full strength. Set to 0 to disable.
tier_note: Fractions of the ranked population, not absolute score thresholds. Remainder falls to D. Absolute thresholds against a percentile-derived score pile almost everything into the bottom band.

model_release.rationale: Training compute spans orders of magnitude and separates frontier runs from fine-tunes better than any other single available field.

forum_post.rationale: Karma is the community's own response. A good candidate generator; a poor arbiter, since it also rewards memorials, community drama and in-jokes.

publication.rationale: Citation counts are heavy-tailed; log compresses them into a usable ranking.

incident.rationale: No external signal wired yet. Records score neutral until one exists.

relevance.note: Topical relevance is kept SEPARATE from the score and multiplied in at the end, so it stays visible rather than being buried inside one number.
relevance.kinds_always_relevant_note: Some sources are AI-by-construction. Every row of an AI-models database is on topic regardless of whether the model NAME contains a matching word.
relevance.matching_note: Substring matching makes 'ai' hit 'training', 'domain' and 'explain', which turns this signal into noise.

known_weaknesses: Keyword relevance is English-only and misses topical records phrased unusually.
Karma and citations both accrue over time, so older records are advantaged within their year group unless observation dates are accounted for.
No signal yet distinguishes a landmark paper from a well-promoted one.
incident kind is unscored pending a signal.
